cases.title: A developer selects verbose human output and an operation fails.
cases.source: Supplied guide sections 14-17, as amended; stable inventory refined additively with implementation.
cases.requiredResult: Output identifies application/build/environment, explains the event, and includes the permitted exception/context detail.

cases.source: Supplied guide sections 14-17, as amended; stable inventory refined additively with implementation.
cases.requiredResult: Stdout is a valid command result; every stderr log line is independently parseable JSON with stable identity.

cases.title: An operator changes output settings through environment variables.
cases.source: Supplied guide sections 14-17, as amended; stable inventory refined additively with implementation.

cases.title: Console is Warning and file is Debug.
cases.source: Supplied guide sections 14-17, as amended; stable inventory refined additively with implementation.
cases.requiredResult: Debug events reach the file and are absent from console; expensive work is skipped only when no output is interested.

cases.title: Two experiments execute concurrently across asynchronous boundaries.
cases.source: Supplied guide sections 14-17, as amended; stable inventory refined additively with implementation.
cases.requiredResult: Each event retains its own operation/experiment identifiers and the shared process identity.

cases.title: A recognized setting contains an invalid value.
cases.source: Supplied guide sections 14-17, as amended; stable inventory refined additively with implementation.
cases.requiredResult: Startup fails with the setting name and accepted values, without dumping unrelated environment data.

cases.title: A queue fills or a writer fails.
cases.source: Supplied guide sections 14-17, as amended; stable inventory refined additively with implementation.
cases.requiredResult: Resource use remains bounded, unaffected outputs continue, and rejection/failure counters are truthful.

cases.title: An application stops gracefully with queued events.
cases.source: Supplied guide sections 14-17, as amended; stable inventory refined additively with implementation.
cases.requiredResult: Accepted events reach the documented boundary or the stop result explicitly reports unresolved work and deadline/cancellation.

cases.title: The application restarts and file rotation continues.
cases.source: Supplied guide sections 14-17, as amended; stable inventory refined additively with implementation.

cases.title: A caller mutates a dictionary immediately after logging.
cases.source: Supplied guide sections 14-17, as amended; stable inventory refined additively with implementation.

cases.title: An application uses the Microsoft provider and its scopes.
cases.source: Supplied guide sections 14-17, as amended; stable inventory refined additively with implementation.

cases.title: A collector reads generated structured records.
cases.source: Supplied guide sections 14-17, as amended; stable inventory refined additively with implementation.
cases.requiredResult: Records retain the specified service/env/version and metadata fields, with no raw multiline or ANSI contamination. This proves the output contract, not hosted ingestion.

cases.title: An event contains boundary-size Unicode, a decimal value, and an unsupported object.
cases.source: Supplied guide sections 14-17, as amended; stable inventory refined additively with implementation.
cases.requiredResult: Supported values retain their explicit representations; unsupported or malformed input is rejected and accounted for. Oversized payload is safely truncated into one valid entry within the configured byte cap, with identity/correlation preserved and truncated:true.

cases.title: All normal outputs are disabled.
cases.source: Supplied guide sections 14-17, as amended; stable inventory refined additively with implementation.
cases.requiredResult: Logging calls return filtered/stopped outcomes as specified, do not invoke deferred factories, and produce no ordinary log records.
